expectations.text: Response calls the outfit-suggester driver and uses its output (not freehand suggestions)
expectations.evidence: This without-skill agent independently chose to run the outfit-suggester engine, citing it in the response. Pulled specific items (black graphic tee, indigo jeans, white sneakers) and explained the score.

expectations.text: Suggested outfit is casual or smart-casual — fitting a relaxed indoor birthday party
expectations.evidence: Black graphic tee + indigo straight-leg jeans + white sneakers — correctly casual for a friend's flat birthday party.

expectations.text: Response accounts for the evening setting (not suggesting daytime/work pieces as primary)
expectations.evidence: Mentions lifting the look for Friday evening ('swap sneakers for a chunky loafer or low block heel'), evening accessory tips.

expectations.text: Response does not suggest buying any new items
expectations.evidence: Suggests 'chunky loafer or a low block heel if you have one', 'gold or silver necklace (layered if you've got it)', 'small shoulder bag or clutch' — while hedged with 'if you have one', some suggestions clearly go beyond the existing wardrobe.

expectations.text: Tone is fun and encouraging in Maya's voice — matches the casual party vibe
expectations.evidence: Tone is more editorial/advisor than Maya's voice — uses headers (TOP PICK, ALTERNATIVE 1, ALTERNATIVE 2, WHAT TO AVOID), ends with 'Have a great time at the party!' which is friendly but not distinctly Maya.
